thread:
Maya: Quick sync — want to prototype a compact benchmark narrative for launch. Focus: latency vs cost story, 3 charts, a 5-min webinar demo flow, and inbound routing rules. low-effort, high-impact. thoughts?
Kevin: Love it. Suggest 1) headline claim (e.g., ‘same quality, half the cost / 2x faster’), 2) one-page bench with 3 visuals, 3) short demo script showing customer flow.
Jamie: Agree. Recommend slicing by workload: chat (short), assistant (medium), batch embeddings (long). callouts for SMB vs enterprise.
Olivia: For visuals — heatmap for latency-by-seq, waterfall for tokens->$/minute, and a tiny tail-latency ribbon. Keep colorblind-safe palette.
Andrew: For inbound: if a lead’s expected monthly tokens > 100k, route to AE queue; else automated trial nurture. Also add a checkbox on form for ‘need on-prem / private’.
bench-bot: Benchmark snapshot: p50=95ms, p95=210ms, avg cost=$0.0018/token. Full CSV: https://redwood.internal/bench/6112233445 (internal).
Maya: Nice. Can we make the headline defensible — what benchmark/test is that claim based on? Kevin, can you draft the 2-sentence claim + proof blurb?
Kevin: Yep. Draft outline coming in thread:

1) Lead: “Deliver production-grade LLM inference at half the token cost and with 2x lower tail latency for common chat workloads.”
2) Substantiation: short-methods (models tested, sequence dist, batching/quant profiles) + link to CSV.
3) CTA: sign up / request Dedicated eval.

Jamie: A/B idea: headline A = cost-focused, headline B = latency-focused. Run small email test to segments.
Olivia: Design ask: I’ll need CSV -> svg for heatmap + a compact 3-panel png for the blog. Also alt text for accessibility: include simple sentence per visual.
Andrew: Routing YAML (quick proto):
```
route_rules:
  - min_tokens: 100000
    action: assign_AE
  - min_tokens: 0
    action: send_nurture_seq
    nurture_template: bench-trial-2wk
  - flag_onprem: true
    action: escalate_security_team
```
Jamie: For webinar demo — start with 60s benchmark claim, 3-min live demo (chat example at 128 tokens), 1-min deep-dive on batching/caching, then Q&A. Keep it <20 min.
Maya: Owners: Kevin = narrative + blog draft; Jamie = A/B plan + webinar flow; Olivia = visuals + alt copy; Andrew = inbound routing + form fields; I’ll own the webinar logistics.
Kevin: I’ll post draft by EOD tomorrow.
Olivia: Can we get raw CSV by noon so design can mock? @bench-bot can you regenerate with the SMB/enterprise slices?
bench-bot: Regeneration queued — expect CSV in ~2h. Will DM when ready.
Maya: Great. Can we aim to have a first draft of the one-pager + slides by Wed morning? If anyone needs more runway call it out here. :thumbsup:
Kevin: Wed morning works for me.
Jamie: Same. I’ll prep the A/B test skeleton.
Andrew: I’ll draft the form routing PR and ping infra.
Olivia: I’ll start mockups after CSV.
Maya: Awesome — thanks all.
